Questions

Common questions.

Can operators use it on the factory floor?

Yes. Capture screens are built for tablets and phones with large, simple inputs.

Does it connect to our accounting system?

Yes. Production and inventory data flow to your accounting or ERP.

Can it forecast raw material needs?

Yes. Demand forecasts drive raw material and production planning.
